errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven distinct slices, not six.

The description incorrectly maps several labels to their corresponding percentage values. The slice for 1.1% is labeled "Mix-Sound-Music", not "Mix-Sound-Speech". The slice for 2.4% is labeled "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech", not "Mix-Sound-Music". The slice for 8.2% is labeled "Mix-Music-Speech", not "Mix-Sound-Speech".
The description identifies the figure as a pie chart but fails to mention that it is a donut chart (i.e., it has a hollow center), which is a key structural feature.
The slice labeled "Mix-Music-Speech" (8.2%) is rendered in a distinctly darker shade of purple compared to the other slices, which serves as a form of visual emphasis.
